metadata.description: A Claude Code pipeline harness that takes one app idea from deep research through design and planning to a shipped implementation, with exactly two human touchpoints.

plugins.name: hyperbuild
plugins.description: Turns Claude Code into an app factory: one idea prompt in, a researched, designed, planned, and implemented application out, with exactly two human touchpoints. /hyperbuild <idea> runs a 19-step autonomous Stage A — market recon, social sentiment mining, a research audit, PRD and feature specs, stack research, three complete design systems with HTML mockups of every screen, adversarial VISUAL QA that opens every rendered screenshot before you do, project-specific skill generation, and epics/tasks — then stops at a design gate. At that gate you also get two levers: /hyperbuild-revise <change> reworks the idea, a feature, one direction's look, or the epic split, and /hyperbuild-redesign [notes] regenerates the design directions (keeping any letters you name). /hyperbuild-choose a|b|c runs Stage B: scaffold, wave-parallel implementation with git discipline, adversarial review, and a traceability ship gate that ends in a working app.
